text: Kalshi to GitHub: built. v0.114.6 is releasing now: install it, then Settings > Cloud scan > Send my API keys (it also sends by itself when a key changes). The Kalshi Key ID + private key go up as sealed GitHub secrets, and the engine uses them for signed reads and Kalshi's socket (it only reads; no engine code can place a Kalshi order). The engine's start-up line will say 'Kalshi: signed key present, socket on'. BoltOdds docs: already fully used incl. auto-reconnect (see my other reply).
